page.layout: One block of text: a centred heading "ERRATA:" at the top, then a list of errata lines in the middle of the page; below them a decorative printer's ornament (not text). No margins with text. Digitiser's watermark at bottom right is ignored.

main_text.head: ERRATA:
main_text.l: pag. 409. lin. 14. post eam, adde: molem.

page.notes: The ornament below the list is a printer's fleuron of dots and a parenthesised circle, with no letters; it is not transcribed. Scattered specks and show-through are omitted. The errata lines are set in a list, so each is one line. Some letters in the list are slightly blurred (e.g. "disferemus", "possit"), transcribed as I read them; "disferemus" is printed as "disferemus" in the scan and "possit" as "poffit".
